answer: The atlas schedule is applied in signal and nadir makes public each instalment. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split which means 41% arrives at settlement and the rest over 18 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 3747 identities would post 3823 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
